crossRefs.note: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, Yahweh; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned…
Yahweh, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned…
In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and…
In that day, sing to her, “A pleasant vineyard!
It will blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing. Lebanon’s glory will be given to it, the excellence…
Then Yahweh’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads.…
You who tell good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who tell good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with…
Sing to Yahweh a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is…
Sing, you heavens, for Yahweh has done it! Shout, you lower parts of the earth! Break out into singing, you mountains…
Those ransomed by Yahweh will return, and come with singing to Zion. Everlasting joy shall be on their heads. They will…
How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news, who…
“Sing, barren, you who didn’t give birth; break out into singing, and cry aloud, you who didn’t travail with child: for…
Thanksgiving will proceed out of them with the voice of those who make merry. I will multiply them, and they will not…
They will come and sing in the height of Zion, and will flow to the goodness of Yahweh, to the grain, to the new wine…
the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those…
Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.
Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion; for, behold, I come, and I will dwell within you,’ says Yahweh.

translations.web: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of Yahweh. They cry aloud from the sea.
translations.bsb: They raise their voices, they shout for joy; from the west they proclaim the majesty of the LORD.
translations.kjv: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.
translations.asv: These shall lift up their voice, they shall shout; for the majesty of Jehovah they cry aloud from the sea.
